review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.fact: enumerate-blocks.mjs legacy flat mode filters top-level children to type==='FRAME' only, so a Loop/section whose direct children are component INSTANCEs (e.g. two 'Dialogue box' instances with no State/Flows groups) yields 0 blocks. Workaround that stays in-harness: fetch the raw /nodes JSON, relabel the target INSTANCE children to type 'FRAME', run `from-nodes`, and export frame PNGs separately (from-nodes does not export them). Candidate general fix: legacy flat mode should accept INSTANCE (and other CONTAINER types) as top-level state frames.

Figma button/component instances can render a visible border in the exported PNG while the REST node reports strokes:[] (the stroke lives on the component master, not the instance override). Delta-compare only gates asserted properties, so add the visible border for visual fidelity but give the element an explicit height so box-sizing:border-box absorbs it and the measured height still matches the design node.
